# Sami Halawa — Senior / Lead AI Engineering Portfolio

Sami Halawa is a Senior / Lead AI Engineer in Madrid building production systems across agentic AI, RAG, MCP, voice and automation with Python and TypeScript. End-to-end product ownership and technical leadership support that core engineering identity.
